target_definition: T+6 open divided by T+1 open minus one, industry and log-float-market-cap neutralized and cross-sectionally ranked

execution_label_price_bases.tradability: raw OHLC and raw exchange limits
execution_label_price_bases.limit_rule: same one-price limit rule as run_portfolio

rejected_target.name: target_path_rank
rejected_target.reason: The path target beat endpoint return and Sharpe only in 2021, lost in 2022 and 2023, and worsened full-period drawdown by 2.68 percentage points. Its 0.63-point lead under the 20bp fixed-path stress was insufficient to pass the preregistered stability gates.

selection_basis: The eight engineered features were fixed for both candidates. The endpoint target passed the preregistered development-period choice after raw-price one-price-limit execution semantics were aligned with the portfolio engine, before the physically separate holdout was scored.
unmet_gates: Holdout annual return does not exceed the CSI 300 benchmark.
Deflated Sharpe Ratio and complete multiple-testing inventory are not evaluated.
Announcement-quality financial PIT data and forward paper trading are not complete.
